verdict.rationale: Zoho Invoice has a customer portal and recurring invoices, which makes this subscription-lifecycle question fair to ask. But the evidence describes the portal only as giving clients access to their transactions. Nothing shows customers upgrading, downgrading, or cancelling plans themselves through a hosted portal or embeddable components, so the portal and recurring billing are adjacent features, not the capability.

support.subject: As a founder, my customers can upgrade, downgrade, or cancel themselves through a hosted portal or embeddable components, without a support ticket
